{"article_id":"Art. 30","resource_uri":"onedrive://legal/contracts/card-processing-cardaxis.md","start":1,"end":37,"quote":"3: # Card Top-Up Processing Agreement
5: Parties: PayRo SRL and CardAxis Processing Ltd
6: Contract ID: CTR-2023-009
7: Status: active · Effective: 2023-11-01 · Renewal: 2026-11-01
8: Services: processing of card top-ups into PayRo payment accounts
9: Supports a critical or important function: not assessed

12: ## 1. Services and functions
13: The Provider processes card top-ups for PayRo customers. Subcontracting requires notice.
15: ## 2. Locations of data processing
16: Card data is processed in Ireland and the Netherlands. Changes of location are notified in advance.
18: ## 3. Data protection
19: The Provider ensures availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of card and customer data, including personal data.
21: ## 4. Access, recovery and return of data
22: PayRo can access, recover and obtain the return of transaction records in an easily accessible format on termination or insolvency.
24: ## 5. Service levels
25: Service level: 99.9% authorisation availability, measured monthly.
27: ## 6. Assistance in ICT incidents
28: The Provider assists PayRo at no additional cost during an ICT incident.
30: ## 7. Cooperation with competent authorities
31: The Provider fully cooperates with the competent authorities and resolution authorities.
33: ## 8. Termination
34: Either party may terminate with 90 days' notice.
36: ## 9. Security awareness and training
37: The Provider takes part in PayRo's ICT security awareness programmes and resilience training.","obligation":"The contract lacks assessment of criticality or importance of the function as required by Art. 30 and related clauses; this must be added to comply with the Regulation.","action":"CONTRACT_REVIEW","confidence":0.9}
